# telnyx_external_connection_upload_status (Data Source)

The number of pending upload requests of an external connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id.

### Read-Only

- `pending_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers that are pending assignment to the external connection.
- `pending_orders_count` (Number) The count of number uploads that have not yet been uploaded to Microsoft.
